Are they standing? Thank you. I would especially like to take this opportunity to recognize and give appreciation for Dr. Cotton who is retiring after this school year. Dr. Cotton has devoted more than three decades to public education, beginning his career as a fifth grade teacher in Chesapeake, serving as superintendent of Henry County Public Schools and ultimately returning home to lead Chesapeake Public Schools in 2018.

Throughout his tenure, he has led with both expertise and heart, guiding Chesapeake Public Schools through a pandemic while raising students' achievement, expanding career and technical education, and ensuring students graduate college and career ready.

He also led Chesapeake to become the first school division in Virginia to achieve a 100% Purple Star designation honoring our military families. A trusted partner to the Chesapeake Legislative Delegation, Dr. Cotton's leadership has been recognized statewide, including being named Virginia Superintendent of the Year in 2019 and Region 2 Superintendent of the Year in 2025.

We're deeply grateful for his extraordinary service and wish him the very best in a well-earned retirement.
